etsy_description:
Welcome to the jungle of bones — this Guns N' Roses skeleton hoodie channels the untamed energy of the Appetite for Destruction era when GNR owned the Sunset Strip and rewrote the rules of rock and roll. The bold skeleton design merges skull imagery with the raw aesthetic that made Slash, Axl, and the boys the most dangerous band on the planet.

Printed on premium heavyweight fleece, this gothic pullover delivers comfort and durability whether you're front row at a show or prowling city streets after midnight. The skeleton artwork captures that perfect collision of glamour and decay that defined 1980s Hollywood rock.

This isn't nostalgia fashion — it's a declaration that real rock and roll never dies, it just sheds its skin. Perfect as a heavy metal gift for fans who still believe guitars should scream and frontmen should terrify. Pair with ripped denim, leather, and zero apologies.

Unisex fit. Multiple sizes available. Designed and printed in the USA. Not for everyone — only for those with an appetite that never got satisfied.
